title: Care-team tasks
subtitle: Follow-up tasks for {{facility}}: assign authorised health workers, track contact and confirm evidenced completion.
overdueHint: Derived from the due date a person set. Not a clinical timing rule.

empty.unassigned: Every open task at {{facility}} has a health worker
empty.unableToReach: No tasks marked unable to reach

announce.movedTo: Task saved. It now appears in: {{tabs}}.

workload.title: Health worker workload
workload.body: Open and overdue tasks per authorised health worker, to share work fairly.
workload.empty: No authorised health workers at this facility.

dialog.failed: Your entries are kept. Try again — the same request is sent, so nothing is saved twice.

errors.invalidTransition: This step is no longer possible for this task. Close and reopen it to see its current status.
errors.workerNotAuthorised: This health worker is not authorised for this facility. Choose a worker from the list.

assign.title: Assign task
assign.body: Choose an authorised health worker of this facility.
assign.reassignBody: Currently assigned to {{name}}. The previous assignee stays in the task history.
assign.workerHint: Only authorised health workers of this facility are listed, with their current load.
assign.dueHint: Shown in Kigali time. Must be later than now.

statusDialog.title: Record status
statusDialog.body: Record the latest contact with the patient.

hint.unable_to_reach: The patient could not be reached. The task can then be reassigned.

statusDialog.reasonCode: Why the patient could not be reached

complete.title: Record completion
complete.body: Completion needs a time, an outcome and an evidence type.
complete.notEvidence: A reminder or message being sent is not evidence that the follow-up happened.

confirm.title: Review reported completion
confirm.body: A health worker reported this task as completed. Confirm it, or return it to the worker with a reason.

returnToWorker.title: Return task to the worker
returnToWorker.body: The task goes back to the worker as contacted. Explain what is missing.
returnToWorker.change: Return the task to the worker

note.title: Add note
note.body: Notes are added to the task history and cannot be edited later.
note.label: Note

create.title: Create task
create.body: Create a follow-up task for a decided review. Only one open task of each type per review.
create.none: No decided reviews need a new task.

drawer.title: Task
drawer.description: Follow-up task details, history and actions.
drawer.denied: This task belongs to another facility and cannot be opened here. The attempt was recorded.
drawer.newerVersion: Someone saved a newer version of this task (version {{version}}). You are still viewing the version you opened.
drawer.wf02Hint: Demo: to see a version conflict, open Settings in another tab and choose “Simulate worker updating follow-up”, then come back and save a change here.
drawer.offline: You are offline (simulated). Changes are disabled; the task stays readable.
drawer.noPermission: Your role can add notes but cannot assign or complete tasks.

conflict.title: This task changed while you were working
conflict.body: Someone else saved this task after you opened it. Nothing has been overwritten. Choose what to do.
conflict.reapplyBlocked: Your change no longer fits the latest version. Keep the latest version and start again.
conflict.previewTitle: Re-apply your change on the latest version?
conflict.previewBody: Your change will be saved on version {{version}}. Check the result:

corrections.title: Record correction requests
corrections.body: Requests from patients to check an item in their record. Resolving a request never changes the record itself.
corrections.resolveBody: Choose the outcome. The patient sees approved wording for it, never free text.
corrections.outcomeHint: Make any actual correction to the record separately (with a reason).
corrections.conflict: This request was changed by someone else. Refresh the page and try again.

toast.keptLatest: Kept the latest version — your change was not saved
toast.reapplied: Your change was saved on the latest version
